decided.singular: Days where the daily max reached about 6.3 or more and the mean went above about 4.8 stood clearly above the 2-4 values around them; day 1 (max 8.0) and day 316 (max 8.667) were the most extreme.
decided.recurrence: The local peaks fall roughly every 27 days (about 1, 28, 58, 85, 111, 137, 164, 187, 220, 245, 273, 303, 329, 355), and the pattern holds through most of the year.
decided.quarter: Q2 has the most and the longest runs of high values (95, 106, 121-125, 149-155, 164), while Q3 shows many low-value stretches; Q4 is close behind Q2.

answer.guess: A geomagnetic activity index such as Kp (eight 3-hour values per day, values in steps of thirds up to 9), recurring with the 27-day solar rotation.
